summary: v5.1 frontend visual + interaction regression complete. All 12 routes load with no white screens or pageerrors. Settings page renders all three v5.1 panels (INTEGRATION STATUS · 12, SCHEDULED JOBS · 7 with all expected job names, TELEGRAM COMMANDS · 11 with all expected commands). Performance page renders KPI row + ACTIVE POSITIONS / CLOSED POSITIONS collapsible split + OPTIONS PERFORMANCE · PEAK GAIN PER TRADE chart + legacy daily P/L tracker. Lottery page renders KPI row + LOTTERY SCAN button (POST /api/lottery/scan fires correctly, returned 5 screener candidates: MOBX/ZENA/LFVN/IIIV/TOYO) + 4 tabs (CURRENT SCAN / SCREENER / MANUAL / TRACK RECORD). Sidebar nav + build footer + CRT amber/cyan/green palette preserved. Two issues found: (1) HIGH — MANUAL tab does NOT contain the spec-required entry form (ticker/entry/score/risk + Add button); only path to add a manual play is from the SCREENER tab via a prompt() dialog that doesn't expose score/risk inputs; (2) MEDIUM — three legacy pages (ContractsPage, SECPage, PharmaPage) emit React 'unique key prop' console warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires manual entry form fields (ticker, entry_price, lottery_score, risk_amount) + an Add button directly on the MANUAL tab. Current implementation only shows existing manual plays and a placeholder 'No manual plays. Add one from the Screener tab.' The ONLY way to add a manual play is from the SCREENER tab via window.prompt() — and even there the user can only override the entry_price; lottery_score and risk_amount are taken from the screener row (no UI to set them manually). Could not run the spec test case ticker=TESTUI/entry=4.20/score=70/risk=50 because there is no MANUAL-tab form. Existing rows on the MANUAL tab DO expose Settle (data-testid=settle-{ticker}) and → TRADE FLOOR buttons correctly.
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' on /contracts, /sec, /pharma. Non-blocking but pollutes console and indicates list rendering without stable keys.

integration_issues.issue: The LOTTERY SCAN button text is wired `{scanning ? 'SCANNING...' : '▶ LOTTERY SCAN'}` but no visible disabled/loading state was observable in two attempts (button text reverted to default within 500ms even though network call completed in ~4s). The POST /api/lottery/scan call itself fires correctly and SCREENER populates with 5 candidates — so the bug is purely the missing/too-fast loading affordance.

issues: CRT aesthetic (amber/cyan/green on dark, monospace, scanlines) preserved. No purple/violet gradient leaks observed.

action_items: Add an inline entry form to the MANUAL tab in LotteryPage.jsx with four inputs (ticker, entry_price, lottery_score, risk_amount) and a green Add button that POSTs to /api/lottery/manual — backend endpoint already exists and was confirmed working in iteration_9.
Add stable `key` props to mapped list children on ContractsPage, SECPage, PharmaPage to silence React 'unique key prop' warnings.

Consider holding the LOTTERY SCAN button in a 'SCANNING…' / disabled state for the full duration of the POST /api/lottery/scan call (use the awaited Promise; currently the loading state may be unsetting before render commits).
Optional — surface the existing scan trigger via the LOTTERY SCAN button on the MANUAL tab too so users don't have to leave the tab to refresh candidates.
critical_code_review_comments: LotteryPage.jsx lines 131-189: MANUAL tab branch never renders a `<form>` or input fields; spec-vs-impl drift. The Screener-only ADD flow uses window.prompt() (line 112) — replace with a proper inline form for accessibility and to expose all four spec fields.

LotteryPage.jsx settle flow (lines 158-170) uses window.prompt() + window.alert() — works, but inconsistent with the rest of the Bloomberg CRT design language which uses dedicated panels. Consider an inline 'EXIT PRICE' input row that appears on Settle click.
Three list-rendering React warnings (ContractsPage/SECPage/PharmaPage) — likely using array index as key or no key at all; trivial fix but indicates absence of an eslint react/jsx-key rule in CI.

rca of the issue: Bug — Lottery MANUAL tab missing entry form: Repro: visit /lottery → click 'MANUAL · 0' tab → observe only a placeholder text 'No manual plays. Add one from the Screener tab.' (no form fields, no Add button). Source: /app/frontend/src/components/LotteryPage.jsx lines 131-189 — the {tab === 'manual'} branch only renders the ACTIVE MANUAL PLAYS table (empty-state OR existing rows) and the MANUAL TRACK RECORD card. There is no <form> for entry. The backend POST /api/lottery/manual endpoint exists and was verified live in iteration_9.json (test_v9_api.py::test_01_manual_add). Mitigation: add a small form Card above the ACTIVE MANUAL PLAYS card on the manual branch with 4 controlled inputs and a button calling axios.post(`${API}/lottery/manual`, {ticker, entry_price, lottery_score, risk_amount}) → reloadAll().
